notes.title: Update 1.7.6a
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247916/069cc1fa070352868a8d24d447a03f218b2e7125.png"]

The update notes for version 1.7.6b are as follows:

🌻 Added support for MacOS.

🌻 Fixed an issue where the system language would not automatically set correctly for Simplified or Traditional Chinese.

notes.title: Update 1.7.6
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the game couldn't be launched if the save file was corrupted.
 Resolved a display issue where the screen was cut off when using a tall aspect ratio.
